errors.name: RoomNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested room is not found in the system.

errors.name: GuestNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested guest is not found in the system.

errors.name: BookingNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested booking is not found in the system.

errors.name: RoomAlreadyBookedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to book a room during a period that is already occupied.

errors.name: InvalidDateError
errors.description: Raised when a check-in or check-out date is invalid, such as a check-in date that is after the check-out date.

errors.name: DuplicateBookingError
errors.description: Raised when the system detects a duplicate booking attempt for the same room and date range, indicating a data inconsistency.
